title: OmniSim startup failure loses ownership of the launched process
summary: tools/alpaca_omnisim_conformu.py:111-114 starts a child then waits for readiness before returning it. A readiness exception prevents caller assignment at290, so finally stops None and leaves the child/session alive. Establish ownership before waiting or clean up inside start_omnisim on exception. A pure fake-Popen/readiness test confirms ownership loss; no actual child/network operation. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (ROOT-2). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
